description:
Read .lattice/notes/design-decisions-2026-07-04.md first. It binds this task.

Releases are manual and happen when a new model ships. A person approves each run because runs cost money.

Write a Claude Code skill (SKILL.md in this repo) that walks the operator through:
1. Confirm the new model's id, provider and reasoning-toggle options.
2. Produce the cost sheet from the measurement doc (DB-7) and get approval before spending.
3. Run the evaluation grid with batch APIs.
4. Run the data pipeline (DB-5).
5. Rebuild and redeploy the site (DB-6).
6. Compare results with earlier suite-version runs as a sanity check.
7. Draft the release writeup for Valerie's external platform: what the new model did, surprises, one or two transcript exhibits.

Depends on DB-5 and DB-7.
title: Release-cadence skill: new-model-drop to refreshed charts
